title: Bangkok Gets a Month of Rain in Weekend, Disrupting City
summary: Bangkok received nearly a month’s worth of rain in a single weekend, flooding roads and homes across the Thai capital, and forcing the government to close public offices and postpone economic data releases.

title: Grains Fall as Traders Seek China Buying Signs After Tariff Cuts
summary: Crop futures eased after the US and China detailed plans to cut tariffs on a slew of agricultural products, with traders awaiting concrete signs of purchases in the wake of last week’s summit between leaders Donald Trump and Xi Jinping.

title: PIMCO's Bowe on Australian Bonds Outlook
summary:
Adam Bowe, Managing Director and Head of Australia Portfolio Management at PIMCO, discusses the outlook for Australia's bond market ahead of the RBA's September policy decision, with markets assessing the likelihood of a further 25-basis-point rate increase.
He says Australia's rate-hike cycle is fully priced in and the cracks in the economy are being more visible.
He speaks with Haidi Stroud-Watts on "Bloomberg: The Asia Trade". (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Pimco Sees Value in Australian Bonds as Rate Hikes Overpriced
summary: Pacific Investment Management Co. is taking an increasingly constructive stance on Australian bonds, arguing that market expectations for interest-rate hikes have gone too far in the face of a slowing local economy.

title: Aida: Japan’s Defense Buildup Won’t Rattle Markets
summary: Takuji Aida, Chief Japan Economist at Credit Agricole and an economic advisor to Japanese Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi, says any expansion of Japan’s defense spending will likely be spread over many years and shouldn’t become a source of significant market anxiety in any single year. He speaks with Shery Ahn on Bloomberg: The Asia Trade. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Chinese Stocks Hit One-Year Low as Chip, Optical Firms Slide
summary: Chinese shares touched a one-year low, led by a selloff in technology firms after a report that authorities may allow purchases of Nvidia Corp.’s new chips and proposed US sanctions on foreign optical producers.

title: Japan’s Two-Year Bond Yield Nears 2% as BOJ Rate Hike Bets Mount
summary: Japan’s two-year government bond yield is closing in on the key 2% threshold as investors ramp up bets on further Bank of Japan rate hikes.

title: Emerging Stocks Slide as Oil Gains on Renewed Mideast Tensions
summary: Emerging-market equities declined, weighed by higher oil prices and global bond yields after US President Donald Trump rejected Iran’s latest proposal to reopen the Strait of Hormuz.

title: Financial Stress Spreads in Europe as Leverage Mounts, BCG Says
summary: One in six companies in western Europe is under financial strain as rising leverage leaves businesses more vulnerable to shocks, according to Boston Consulting Group.

title: Cuba Warns US Sanctions Are Blocking Reform
summary: Cuban Deputy Foreign Minister Carlos Fernández de Cossío tells Bloomberg This Weekend host David Gura that Cuba remains ready for talks with the US, but says continued sanctions and economic pressure are hampering the island’s efforts to reform its economy. De Cossío also says Cuba would welcome greater US investment and hopes the confrontation can ultimately end through negotiations. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Bond Selloff Resumes as Oil Rises After Trump Spurns Iran Offer
summary: A selloff in Treasuries resumed Monday as oil rallied after President Donald Trump rejected Iran’s latest proposal to reopen the Strait of Hormuz, intensifying inflation concerns.

summary: Long-time bond investor Chris Iggo is retiring with a parting message for markets: after four difficult years, bonds are set for a rebound.

title: Bonds Drop With Stocks as Iran Tensions Boost Oil: Markets Wrap
summary: Bonds and stocks dropped after President Donald Trump rejected Iran’s latest proposal to reopen the Strait of Hormuz, denting some of the optimism that lifted markets late last week. The dollar strengthened, while precious metals sold off.

title: Copper Slides as China Industrial Data Weighs on Demand Outlook
summary: Copper and other base metals retreated ahead of a weeklong holiday in China, as traders assessed the country’s demand outlook following slower growth in industrial profits.

title: SK Hynix Shares Fall as Solidigm’s Potential US IPO Sours Mood
summary: SK Hynix Inc. shares fell as media reports of a potential listing of the chipmaker’s US subsidiary added to concerns over its complex ownership structure.

title: GoTo Shares Plunge After Stock Exchange Removes Price Floor
